import json,os,subprocess,pwd,shutil
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
sha='292aeb7d10eecef8c3ca84760cd579e84e4b97f3'
current=root/'current'
stage=root/'.staging'/sha
services=['ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads']
def health():
 return {name:subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet',name],timeout=6).returncode==0 for name in services}
state={'task':'ferrari-legacy-hygiene-script-staged-audit-only','target_sha':sha,'status':'BLOCKED','pre_service_health':health(),'previous_active':str(current.resolve(strict=True))}
assert state['previous_active'].endswith('70458fc1b44102b440d2d4c335b5e54f5279f25c')
assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink() and not stage.exists() and not stage.is_symlink()
assert root.stat().st_uid!=0 and all(state['pre_service_health'].values())
owner=pwd.getpwuid(root.stat().st_uid).pw_name
def call(args,t=120,cwd=None):
 return subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','-H','-u',owner,*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=t,cwd=cwd,env={**os.environ,'GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT':'0','GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0'})
try:
 r=call(['git','ls-remote','--heads','https://github.com/martaxi-boss/skill-universal.git','main'],t=30)
 state['main_sha_at_preflight']=r.stdout.split()[0] if r.returncode==0 and r.stdout else None
 assert state['main_sha_at_preflight']==sha
 r=call(['git','clone','--depth','1','--branch','main','https://github.com/martaxi-boss/skill-universal.git',str(stage)],t=95)
 assert r.returncode==0 and stage.is_dir()
 x=call(['git','-C',str(stage),'rev-parse','HEAD'],t=10)
 state['clone_sha']=x.stdout.strip()
 assert x.returncode==0 and state['clone_sha']==sha
 tests=call(['python3','-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-q'],cwd=str(stage),t=80)
 state['unit_tests_success']=tests.returncode==0
 state['test_summary']=[line for line in tests.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(('Ran ','OK','FAILED'))][-3:]
 assert state['unit_tests_success']
 audit=call(['python3',str(stage/'install/ferrari_alias_retirement.py')],t=45,cwd=str(stage))
 state['audit_exit']=audit.returncode
 state['audit']=json.loads(audit.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]) if audit.stdout.strip() else None
 assert state['audit_exit']==0 and state['audit']['status']=='AUDIT'
 assert state['audit']['alias_present'] and state['audit']['old_fallback_preserved']
 assert set(state['audit']['launchers_needing_migration'])=={'apktool','valkey-server'}
 assert state['audit']['essential_services_active']==9
 assert state['audit']['external_process_consumers']==0
 state['status']='PASS_STAGED_AUDIT_READY_TO_APPLY'
except Exception as exc:
 state['error']=str(exc)[:180]
 if stage.is_dir() and not stage.is_symlink():
  shutil.rmtree(stage)
 state['stage_cleaned_on_failure']=not stage.exists()
state['post_service_health']=health()
state['active_after']=str(current.resolve(strict=True))
state['pass']=state['status']=='PASS_STAGED_AUDIT_READY_TO_APPLY' and state['pre_service_health']==state['post_service_health'] and state['active_after']==state['previous_active']
print(json.dumps(state,sort_keys=True))
if not state['pass']:raise SystemExit(4)
